title: Tracheostomy Speaking Valve
indications_limitations: <p>A trachea tube has been determined to satisfy the definition of a prosthetic device, and the tracheostomy speaking valve is an add on to the trachea tube which may be considered a medically necessary accessory that enhances the function of the tube. In other words, it makes the system a better prosthesis. As such, a tracheostomy speaking valve is covered as an element of the trachea tube which makes the tube more effective.</p>
revision_history: <p>  08/1988 - Provided coverage as an accoutrement to trachea tube. Effective date 09/09/1988. (TN 30)</p>
